role: fresh within-training-domain S0 component selection; not final test
stopping_rule: same actual objective-evaluation cap including initialization and feasibility boost; at most 200 generations
oos_reference: fixed training normalization and reference; feasible re-evaluated solutions only
model_policy: frozen existing supervised models; no refitting; retain original feature encoding and generation-10 mutation activation
selection_rule: rank single components by equal-instance mean paired final-HV percent vs BASE; report paired CIs and rule comparisons; combined arm is separate; no automatic PPO or checkpoint changes; if any BASE HV is zero, rank by absolute normalized HV gain over all pairs and mark relative percentages undefined
